text: A cube of side 6 cm is painted yellow on all faces and cut into smaller cubes of side 2 cm. How many smaller cubes will have exactly two faces painted?
explanation: n = 6 / 2 = 3. Number of cubes with 2 faces painted = 12 * (n - 2) = 12 * (3 - 2) = 12 * 1 = 12.
